title: 第21章 小和尚纳命来第22章 为谁而战
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
‘呯’
‘嗯·哼’
正赶往剑锋的云阳被大树上忽然跳下的黑影一拳轰飞，
顿时鼻血染红了下巴，
滚下狭窄的山路坡地，
脑袋嗡嗡嗡的眼冒金星，
但顾不及疼痛，
一骨碌继续向山下翻滚，
‘呯嘭’
刚才挡住他的一个山石成为碎片四处飚射，
‘小和尚，纳命来，’
黑影一拳砸中山石，
庞大的身影如兔子一般灵巧在山坡跳跃。
云阳这些天因为筑体基本完成，老佛又不传授功法，感觉进步放缓，
卡在徒境·八级止步不前，
而且他在与石桑的格杀中，严重感觉到系统功法和武器的重要性，
上次击杀石桑，灵汐在一旁压制威胁，加上磨骨出其不意才成功的，
没有灵汐在的底气，他相信死的是自己，
侥幸不会永远存在，必须自己变强，
所以准备到玄极剑在剑锋·剑院修习系统剑法，

正值黎明前的黑暗，
浓浓的大雾潆绕在山中，
结果冷不伶仃挨了偷袭，
终于躲过二次攻击反应过来，
一个鹞子翻身一跃而起，不退反进；
‘天昭神拳，爆！’
‘呯’，‘咔嚓’，‘嘭嘭’
一大一小身影在重力对拳中倒飞，
元罗不敢相信，这小子已经如此强大，
他以为自己这段时间吞噬尸体已经飞快的提升，
居然还是被隐隐约约压制，现在拳击不但灵魂剧痛，
而且那小子的本力同样上来了，
拳头相击的地方从皮肉到指骨都在穿心疼痛，
但心中的怒火在燃烧，扭曲着灰脸呲牙咧嘴；
‘小咋种，石桑的人头是我的，既然你弄死了他，那我就弄死你，索命拳，死！’
石桑居然破旧的大红婚衣黑气鼓起，等于阴煞罡气护体，
让本就庞大的体型更加庞大，
但速度不减，
跑中带跳一拳狠狠地砸像云阳，
看着元罗愤怒的表情，云阳一脸懵逼，这是咋回事，

‘呯’，‘嘭’
元罗被打狗棒像球一般重力抽飞，
content_en:
‘Bang’
‘Uh-huh’
Yunyang, who was rushing towards the edge of the sword, was punched away by a black shadow that suddenly jumped down from the tree.
Suddenly the nosebleed stained my chin red,
Rolling down the narrow mountain slope,
My head was buzzing and my eyes were filled with stars,
But I don't care about the pain,
Yigulu continued to roll down the mountain,
‘Bang bang’
The rock that blocked him just now became fragments and flew everywhere.
'Little monk, come and accept your fate,'
The black shadow hit the mountain rock with a punch,
The huge figure jumped up and down the hillside as nimbly as a rabbit.
Yunyang has basically completed the construction of the body these days, and the old Buddha does not teach the exercises, so he feels that his progress has slowed down.
Stuck in the apprentice state at level eight, unable to move forward.
Moreover, during his battle with Shi Sang, he seriously felt the importance of systematic skills and weapons.
The last time he killed Shi Sang, Ling tide was on the side to suppress the threat, and Mo Gu succeeded by taking him by surprise.
Without the confidence of Lingxi, he believed that he was the one who died.
Luck will not exist forever, you must become stronger yourself,
So prepare to go to Xuanji Sword to practice systematic swordsmanship at Jianfeng Sword Academy.
It's the darkness before dawn,
Thick fog hangs in the mountains,
As a result, Leng Bulingding was attacked by surprise.
Finally escaped the second attack and reacted,
A kite turns over and leaps into the air, advancing instead of retreating;
‘Tianzhao Divine Fist, explode! ’
‘Bang’, ‘click’, ‘bang bang’
The figures, one large and one small, flew upside down in the gravity punch,
Yuan Luo couldn't believe that this kid was already so powerful.
He thought that his devouring corpses had improved rapidly during this period.
Unexpectedly, he was still vaguely suppressed. Now boxing not only causes severe pain in the soul,
And that boy's strength has also improved,
The place where the fists hit each other was painful from the skin to the phalanges.
But the anger in his heart was burning, his gray face twisted and his teeth bared;
'Young bastard, Shi Sang's head belongs to me. Since you killed him, I will kill you. Death fist, die! ’
Shi Sang's shabby red wedding dress was bulging with black energy, which was equivalent to Yin evil energy protecting the body.
Make the already huge body even bigger,
But the speed does not slow down,
He jumped while running and punched Xiang Yunyang hard.
Seeing Yuan Luo's angry expression, Yunyang was confused. What was going on?
‘Bang’, ‘bang’
Yuan Luo was whipped away by the force of the dog-beating stick like a ball.
